subject: POC charter & kickoff confirmation — ZenOptics
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@zenoptics.io>, David Li <david.li@zenoptics.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC charter & kickoff confirmation — ZenOptics

Hi Maya, David —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Short recap and suggested next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into kickoff. Let me know if I mischaracterized anything.

Quick recap of pain points you described:
- Search results are noisy for product docs and specs (relevance suffers for short queries).
- Support agents spend ~20–30% of their time triaging and re-writing model responses.
- Latency variability causes timeouts in your in-app assistant on peak days.

POC goals (what success looks like):
1) Improve retrieval relevance so top-3 results are accurate for >85% of queries in our eval set.
2) Reduce agent triage time by 30% through better prompt templates + reranking.
3) Meet latency SLO: p95 generation latency <200ms for 512-token context in our staging environment.
4) Demonstrate cost per session projection with Redwood Optimize suggestions.

Proposed POC scope (30-day pilot):
- Data: ingest product docs, support transcripts (sample up to 50k docs).
- Features: embeddings & semantic search + reranking, low-latency assistant for troubleshooting flows, prompt/eval harness for re-ranking metrics.
- Deliverables: evaluation report (precision/recall, latency), prompt set and baseline outputs, runbook for production handoff.

Owners & roles:
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (AM, primary), Lauren Bishop (Solutions Eng, infra & prompts), Hannah Schmitt (CS, adoption metrics)
- ZenOptics: Maya Patel (Product), David Li (Engineering lead)

Timeline (target):
- 5/13 — ZenOptics provides sample dataset (anonymized).
- 5/14–5/18 — IAC/provisioning and raw ingest to staging; create access roles.
- 5/19–5/25 — Prompt engineering + initial eval runs (baseline).
- 5/26–6/11 — Iterations: reranking, latency tuning (batching/quantization suggestions).
- 6/14 — Final demo + handoff; delivery of evaluation report.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm the sample dataset delivery date (you said ~5/13 on the call).
2) Open an S3 bucket or share a secure link and add redwood-poc service account as read-only (we detail perms below).
3) Introduce procurement contact for SOW & billing (cc'd if available).

Attachments: 'poc_blueprint_notes.txt' (high-level checklist) — I'll send a formal SOW draft once you confirm scope.

If this all looks right I'll queue a 30-min kickoff for next week for infra walk-through and get the SOW over to procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Karthik — thanks, this is helpful and broadly aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Procurement & contracting: I've looped in our procurement team (procure@zenoptics.io). We'll need an estimate for committed hours and expected billables for the 30-day pilot to expedite internal approvals.
2) Deployment mode: We're evaluating whether hosted Redwood API is sufficient or if we need a private VPC deployment due to customer data residency. Can you include a short note on differences/impact on timeline?
3) Data: we'll provide a sampled inventory by 5/13 — attaching the current inventory matrix (zenoptics_data_inventory.xlsx). It's redacted but shows doc counts by repo.

Two smaller asks:
- Can Redwood provide a recommended IAM role/policy to create in our AWS account (least privilege) and the recommended bucket naming?
- Any preliminary expectations on tokenization / special pre-processing for CAD drawings metadata (we have mixed PDF + SVG + embedded text).

Once we have the SOW draft and a notch on procurement approval, we can confirm the kickoff window. I think target weeks you proposed look feasible.

Regards,
Maya Patel

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@zenoptics.io>, David Li <david.li@zenoptics.io>, Procurement <procure@zenoptics.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC charter & kickoff confirmation — ZenOptics

Thanks Maya — appreciate the fast turnaround and the inventory file. Attached is our initial SOW (redwood_poc_sow_v1.pdf) and a prompt/eval template (zenoptics_prompt_set_template.xlsx) to seed the eval. Below are the concrete answers to your points plus the exact provisioning steps to unblock infra.

Hosted vs Private (short):
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding (no infra changes), target timeline ~2–3 business days to provision test keys once we have sample data. Suitable if data is not subject to strict residency controls.
- Private (VPC): adds ~2 weeks for network setup, KMS integration, and customer validation. We'll do a small stub of private infra in parallel if you prefer, but expect longer procurement lead time.

Estimated pilot billing (ballpark):
- Hosted: ~$9k–12k for the 30-day POC including compute, storage, and engineering hours (detailed breakdown in SOW).
- Private: additional setup fee + cloud connector costs (SOW line items).

Data & provisioning (recommended least-privilege steps):
1) Create an IAM role 'redwood-poc-zenoptics' with the following managed policy: read-only on s3://zenoptics-poc-data/* and kms:Decrypt for the key used to encrypt the bucket.
2) Create bucket 's3://zenoptics-poc-data' and upload the sample set into a /sample/ prefix.
3) Add the service-account email redwood-poc@redwood-inference-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com as a trusted principal for cross-account access (we'll provide exact ARN).
4) IP allowlist (optional for hosted): add Redwood egress range x.x.x.0/24 for management plane.

Prompt/eval plan (high level):
- We'll start with your top 200 intents and 500 labeled queries you provide.
- Baseline runs: retrieval+rerank baseline (BM25 + base embedding), then Redwood variants.
- Metrics: precision@3, MRR, latency p95, and a human-rated quality score (0–5) on a 150-sample subset. Target thresholds included in SOW.

Owners & updated timeline:
- 5/13 — ZenOptics sample dataset in s3://zenoptics-poc-data/sample/ (you confirmed 5/13).
- 5/14 — Redwood reads sample and creates staging index.
- 5/17 — Initial baseline eval & prompt pass complete.
- 5/21 — First iteration results + short sync (30 min).
- 6/11 — Final evaluation complete; 6/14 final demo.

Attachments included: redwood_poc_sow_v1.pdf, zenoptics_prompt_set_template.xlsx. I've also exported the checklist as poc_blueprint_notes.txt.

Next concrete items for procurement to move forward:
- Procurement: confirm billing contact and share PO template if you require one.
- ZenOptics engineering: create the IAM role and add the redwood-poc principal; share the bucket ARN when ready.

Would you like a 30-min infra kickoff on Friday 5/14 at 10am PT? I've tentatively blocked time in the calendar draft linked in HubSpot.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_poc_sow_v1.pdf, zenoptics_prompt_set_template.xlsx, poc_blueprint_notes.txt
